subject: Security review kickoff - scope clarification & next steps
messages:
From: Jenna Lopez <j.lopez@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Nguyen <sam.nguyen@acmehealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Aug 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo & discovery — security review kickoff

Marissa — thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and a couple asks so we can get the security intake started: 

- Acme will need a one-page summary of Redwood's SOC 2 scope and evidence availability.
- We also need the intake questionnaire filled out for our security team (see attached).
- Procurement wants an initial timeline for contract review and any procurement prerequisites (PO requirements, standard terms redlines).

Can you confirm who from Redwood will be our day-to-day contact for the security review and who to loop in for procurement-level contract questions? Also please confirm systems in-scope — our security team is particularly concerned about data residency and audit logging.

Thanks,
Jenna
Jenna Lopez
Senior Product Manager, Acme Health
j.lopez@acmehealth.com

Attachment: acme-security-intake-request.pdf (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Lopez <j.lopez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo & discovery — security review kickoff

Hi Jenna — great to connect. Appreciate the clear asks. Per your questions: 

1) Day-to-day security contact: Neha Kapoor (cc'd) — she will lead questionnaire intake and evidence collection.
2) Procurement / contract questions: Rishi Malhotra (cc'd) will handle commercial and redlines; he can work with your procurement contact on PO/terms.
3) Systems in-scope: based on our discussion, please consider the following as the initial scope we expect to cover — we can tighten this after you confirm:
   - Redwood Hosted API (hosted inference endpoints)
   - Dedicated clusters (if used by your account)
   - Console (observability logs and dashboards)
   - Customer-managed Private deployment (if your security team requests an on-prem/VPC option, that will be captured separately)

Next steps I propose: 
- I will attach our SOC 2 summary and the standard security-questionnaire intake template for you to return. (Attached: security-questionnaire-acme.xlsx)
- Neha will follow up with a prioritized list of evidence and an intake call if needed.
- Rishi — could you share Redwood's standard SOW/terms and timing expectations for procurement review?

We aim to keep the initial intake light (questionnaire + evidence folder) and then schedule a 30–45 min kickoff call with your security and procurement teams. Are you available Tue or Wed next week for the kickoff?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (555) 203-1180

Attachments: security-questionnaire-acme.xlsx (stub), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (stub)

From: Jenna Lopez <j.lopez@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Nguyen <sam.nguyen@acmehealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 08:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo & discovery — security review kickoff

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. Quick answers from our side: 

- Economic buyer: Patricia Gomez (SVP Ops) — p.gomez@acmehealth.com (we'll loop her in once we have a clear mutual action plan).
- Security lead: Sam Nguyen (cc'd) will own the technical intake.
- Procurement timeline: we aim for contract review the week of Sep 13; procurement prefers to receive standard terms first so they can kick off internal review (they listed PO and standard T&Cs as the main items).
- Systems confirmed in-scope for the initial review: Hosted API and Console (we are not planning Dedicated or Private now). Data residency: we operate primarily in US regions; Sam will provide any additional constraints.

We'll return the filled questionnaire by EOD Tuesday. I attached a short procurement timeline doc for reference.

Looking forward to the kickoff — Tue Sep 7th (10–11am PT) works for us if that suits Redwood.

Best,
Jenna

Attachment: acme-procurement-timeline.pdf (stub)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Lopez <j.lopez@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo & discovery — security review kickoff

Hi Jenna — thanks for the quick turnaround and for confirming stakeholders. Next steps from Redwood: 

1) We'll review your completed questionnaire once you send it and flag any clarifying questions within 24 business hours.
2) I'll create a shared evidence folder (Drive link copied below) and request specific artifacts (SOC 2 report, architecture diagram, encryption key management notes, retention/audit log examples).
3) Rishi will share our standard terms and a one-page SOW draft via DocuSign for your procurement team to start their review — expect that by Sep 3.
4) Confirmed kickoff: Tue Sep 7, 10:00–10:45am PT — I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda (intake goals + outstanding items + timeline).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4dAcmeSecurityKickoff

If Patricia (economic buyer) wants a short executive summary ahead of the kickoff, Marissa and I can prepare a 1-pager highlighting risk controls, timelines, and commercial milestones.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
